info.title: Telecom Service & Network Management System
info.description: Backend platform for managing telecom customers, plans, SIMs, devices, subscriptions, usage, network infrastructure, outages, support tickets, SLAs and operational analytics.

post.description: Super Admin only: create staff accounts or customer logins linked to a customer profile.
Note: use the account's email address as the 'username' field.

schema.title: Response Customer History Api V1 Customers  Customer Id  History Get
Response Compare Plans Api V1 Plans Compare Post
Response Replacement History Api V1 Sims Customers  Customer Id  Replacements Get

post.description: Upgrade or downgrade is determined automatically by comparing plan prices.

schema.title: Response History Api V1 Subscriptions  Subscription Id  History Get

post.description:
Records (or accumulates onto) a day's usage for a subscription.
Crossing 80% / 100% of any quota raises a one-off usage-threshold notification.

schema.title: Response Sim Usage Api V1 Usage Sims  Sim Id  Get
Response Customer Usage Api V1 Usage Customers  Customer Id  Get

get.description: Equipment with no recent heartbeat (likely down).

schema.title: Response Stale Equipment Api V1 Equipment Stale Get
Response Affected Customers Api V1 Outages  Outage Id  Affected Customers Get

get.description: Use assignment_status=completed for completed jobs, =assigned for pending jobs.

schema.title: Response Assignments Api V1 Technicians  Technician Id  Assignments Get

post.description: Customers can raise tickets for themselves; staff can raise them on behalf of any customer.

schema.title: Response Get Comments Api V1 Tickets  Ticket Id  Comments Get
Response Get History Api V1 Tickets  Ticket Id  History Get
Response List Rules Api V1 Sla Rules Get

get.description:
Tickets that are unresolved and past their SLA deadline.
Pass notify=true to also flag them as breached and raise SLA-breach notifications.

schema.title: Response Breached Api V1 Sla Breached Get
Response Soon To Breach Api V1 Sla Soon To Breach Get
Response Get History Api V1 Service Requests  Request Id  History Get

get.description: Customers see notifications addressed to their customer profile; staff see ones addressed to them.
Staff-only view of generated notifications (optionally for one customer). Used for demo verification.

post.description:
Runs the scheduled maintenance jobs once: auto-renew/expire subscriptions, plan-expiry and
maintenance notifications, and SLA-breach flagging. In production trigger these from cron/Celery beat.
